name: statusline-native
description: In-session Client TUI for statusline configuration

backendExecutable.title: Backend executable
backendExecutable.description: Absolute matching claude-statusline executable; source development can override it with CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NATIVE_EXECUTABLE.

configDir.title: Configuration directory
configDir.description: Claude configuration directory used by the installer; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR takes precedence.

backendVersion.title: Expected backend version
backendVersion.description: Version bound by the installer; empty permits protocol-compatible source development.
